prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.

Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Account Rescue Hint: Display a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging into their existing account restores all previously created pets. (why: Support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets after sign-in. Sign-in hints have a high win rate (6/14 tests).)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Accessory Fitting Flow: Add an interactive accessory fitting sub-flow during adoption where users can try starter hats and collars on their companion before confirmation. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (67.9%, median 89s). Adding interactive pet preview flows improves adoption engagement.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Live Generation Tip Cards: Show revolving interactive desktop tip cards during the waiting screen explaining pet habits while rendering finishes. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s (median 201s). Wait info improvements have 3 wins across 10 tests.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Interaction Hotkey Sub-Flow: Guide users through interactive hotkeys to summon, hide, and talk to their pet directly on the finish screen. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet. Finish new_flow changes have 2 wins in 8 tests.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Cloud Recovery Status Hint: Show a clear security and pet restoration guarantee hint right above the sign-in options. (why: Addresses 8 support tickets regarding lost pets on sign-in and leverages sign-in hint effectiveness (6/14 historical wins).)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Naming & Milestone Screen: Insert a dedicated companion naming and birth certificate milestone screen before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption drops to 67.9% completion. A dedicated naming and milestone step deepens pet attachment before rendering.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Generation Activity Feed Display: Display a dynamic asset construction activity feed on the waiting screen showing rendering progress step-by-step. (why: Home wait stage takes a mean time of 2336s. Keeping users informed of rendering progress reduces drop-off during long wait times.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Cloud Sync Reassurance Hint: Add an explicit data protection hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that account data transfer preserves all existing pet assets. (why: Sign-in hints have strong empirical success (6/14 wins) and directly counter user fear of pet loss mentioned in 8 support emails.)
8: [finish, notification] Finish Step Desktop Pet System Tray Toggle: Add an interactive toggle on the finish screen allowing users to enable system tray quick controls and desktop launch alerts. (why: 7 support emails were about post-onboarding controls/hiding or feature behavior. Enabling tray notifications on finish clarifies background controls.)
